text.en:
In order to perpetuate the memory of the illustrious Secretary of Justice and Chief Justice of the
of Supreme Court of the Philippine Islands, the late Victorino Mapa, the street now called Buenavista in the
City of Manila, a name which bears no recollections for the Filipinos, shall henceforth be known as Victorino
Mapa Street.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 27, 1929.
